generation.scope: For an arbitrary one-dimensional point-fiber graph with pure hull Y the finite discrepancy has length 18-4d+2p_a(Y). Sextics are always pure of genus three with a (2,2) residual in each projection; quintic hulls have genus one or two. The conormal correction to the fixed length excludes embedded structure on every reduced integral hull of degree at least five, and excludes rational quartic hulls.

open_mathematics: Determine the reducible quintic genus-one branch using projective frames and node syzygies, then continue reducible sextics, nonreduced curves and the remaining general AS tests.
